verdict.rationale: Brex documents first-party autonomous agents that run in the background. An audit agent monitors expenses and categorizes violations by risk. A review agent auto-approves low-risk expenses, escalates exceptions and follows up with anyone out of compliance. AI assistants file reimbursements automatically. Admins configure the policy rules, approval routing and auto-blocking that Brex AI applies to every transaction. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on configuring or customizing the agents' behavior beyond policy rules, a general-purpose first-party automation builder (Zapier/Workato flows are third-party), and independent or hands-on corroboration that the agents work as claimed.
